import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['dt']=pd.to_datetime(df['date'],format='mixed')
sub=df[df.account_id=='xz8lX1K'].copy()
A=pd.Timestamp('2025-10-20')
# use flat (non-Mon/Tue) baseline days: 10/15-10/19 + 10/22-10/26
base=sub[~sub.dt.dt.dayofweek.isin([0,1]) & (sub.dt<A)]
n=base.dt.dt.date.nunique()
an=sub[sub.dt==A]
for c in ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']:
    b=base.groupby(c).unblended_cost.sum()/n
    a=an.groupby(c).unblended_cost.sum()
    t=pd.concat([b.rename('base'),a.rename('anom')],axis=1).fillna(0); t['delta']=t.anom-t.base
    print('===',c, 'total delta', round(sub[sub.dt==A].unblended_cost.sum()-base.unblended_cost.sum()/n,2))
    print(t.reindex(t.delta.abs().sort_values(ascending=False).index).head(4).round(2).to_string())
